material_source_sentences.title: Flexible-fuel vehicle
material_source_sentences.text: Flex-fuel vehicles are distinguished from bi-fuel vehicles, where two fuels are stored in separate tanks and the engine runs on one fuel at a time, for example, compressed natural gas (CNG), liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), or hydrogen.

material_source_sentences.title: Hydrogen vehicle
material_source_sentences.text: A hydrogen vehicle is a vehicle that uses hydrogen as its onboard fuel for motive power.

material_source_sentences.title: Hydrogen vehicle
material_source_sentences.text: The power plants of such vehicles convert the chemical energy of hydrogen to mechanical energy either by burning hydrogen in an internal combustion engine, or by reacting hydrogen with oxygen in a fuel cell to run electric motors.

reviews.reason: Flexible-fuel vehicle places hydrogen in its bi-fuel discussion. Hydrogen vehicle includes both combustion and fuel-cell conversion; the universal inference that every hydrogen-powered vehicle must be bi-fuel is not entailed. Human adjudication must assess the question/reference inference.
